open_points.subject: Linux-only release support
open_points.text: “A release runs on Linux and on no other host” is added to A20 rule 3, while State 3 says A20 rule 3 is outside the running kernel and “no module owns” it; its release-artifact paragraph assigns only dependency and sandbox-runtime pinning, recording and verification.
open_points.question: What owns and verifies the new fact that a release is Linux-only, given that the kernel must not test the host or the presence of O_NOFOLLOW at runtime?
options: The external release/build artifact owns and verifies the supported-host constraint alongside dependency pins.
data_provider owns a release host-platform fact, without performing a runtime check.
The statement is support policy only and has no implementation or verification owner.
open_points.default_guess: The external release/build artifact owns and verifies the Linux-only constraint, while no runtime module tests it.
